themes.summary: Ship attacks near Hormuz continued with 13 UKMTO-reported in October, supertankers are turning away from the Gulf per ANZ, yet crossings rose to 22 on Oct. 12 and Gulf crude exports were 11.5 million b/d in the week from Oct. 5.

themes.theme: Russian diesel export relief and Ukraine truce
themes.summary: US waiver and partial Russian ban lift allow 300,000 mt in Oct and 500,000 mt in Nov, but analysts call the volumes small, Zelenskyy denies a truce commitment, and diesel cracks rose on Oct. 13.

themes.theme: Record refining margins and diesel cracks
themes.summary: BP flagged $46.7/b Q3 refining margin and Galp $33.80/b, NYMEX diesel crack reached $113.10/b, and Nasser put diesel near $200/b.
VLCC index at $1.169 million/day and Middle East-China freight near $35/b are depressing FOB differentials such as Doba at -$16.25/b while raising delivered costs.

themes.theme: OPEC+ output recovery against weaker demand outlook
themes.summary: OPEC+ output rose 900,000 b/d (OPEC) or 1.61 million b/d (Platts) in Sept led by Saudi Arabia, while OPEC cut 2026 demand growth to 200,000 b/d.

themes.theme: Bypass routes and Iraq Ceyhan flows
themes.summary: Ceyhan loadings above 500,000 b/d early Oct and Saudi plans for 1.2 million b/d extra pipeline capacity pushed Mediterranean sour differentials to four-week lows.
Aramco says commercial stocks under 6 billion barrels are barely a cushion, ARA distillate stocks are 20% below the five-year average, and BRS sees the market undersupplied by around 4 mb/d.
Iranian crude imports to Chinese independents fell 57.3% m/m in Sept and replacement barrels are offered $12-27/b above ICE Brent, with Cold Lake at record premiums.
